text:
Lena (CS): heads-up — QuasarOps flagged a big QPS spike in APAC during their demo, renewal touchpoint next week. They asked for a temporary QPS bump + IP allowlist so the demo doesn't fail. Can we approve 72h bump to 1500 QPS in ap-southeast-1 and add their proxy CIDRs? @Nish @Kai :rotating_light:

Omar (QuasarOps): confirming CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.128/26. Demo window tomorrow 09:00 SGT — can you make it by then? We're trying to avoid the renewal slipping.

Nish (EngOps): need org_id and project_id for the ACL. If this is hosted, we can route to a soft-quota multi-tenant pool with a temporary override. If dedicated, need capacity lead. ETA: ~6h after approval + ACL. Also will set auto-revoke.

Kai (SRE): what's expected tail latency & token rates? I'll add a short-lived dashboard and an error-rate alert. Also need the start/end timestamps for auto-revoke.

Lena (CS): org_id: quasarops-204, project_id: demo-poc. Auto-revoke: 2026-03-26T09:00:00+08:00 (72h). Renewal note: customer is RISK: they said "won't sign until demo scales" — making this a high-priority enablement. CS ticket CS-12345 linked.

Nish (EngOps): copying a config snippet I'll apply once Kai + infra sign-off. Will attach CIDRs and region.

Nish (EngOps): ```yaml
customer: quasarops-204
project: demo-poc
region: ap-southeast-1
temporary_qps: 1500
auto_revoke: 2026-03-26T09:00:00+08:00
alowlisted_cidrs:
  - 203.0.113.0/24
  - 198.51.100.128/26
notes: "72h POC bump for renewal demo; CS ticket CS-12345"
```

deploy-bot: Created internal ticket OPS-9987 to track the ACL + QPS override. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/OPS-9987

Kai (SRE): I'm on-call tomorrow morning, I'll watch the dashboard and set an alert: high_token_latency > 500ms or error_rate > 3% -> page. Also will add rollout fallback to a smaller model variant if latency spikes.

Nish (EngOps): Applying policy now to the staging gating config, then to prod after a quick smoke test. Command I'll run: `infractl allowlist apply --org quasarops-204 --proj demo-poc --file tmp/quasarops-apac-bump.yaml`

Omar (QuasarOps): appreciate it — timing works. We'll keep traffic constrained to the demo window. Also FYI we'll add a second IP range if needed; will DM Lena.

Lena (CS): thanks all — marking this as high priority. Will follow up in CS-12345 with renewal owner and schedule a 15m sync post-demo. If the bump proves stable, we'll move to discuss committed capacity. :thumbsup:

Kai (SRE): noted. I'll post the dashboard link in the ticket once the metrics stream is live.

Nish (EngOps): done — prod change applied at 2026-03-23T22:12:00Z, auto-revoke set. Rolling monitor now.

deploy-bot: Change OPS-9987 updated: prod change applied by nish. Auto-revoke scheduled 2026-03-26T01:00:00Z UTC.

Lena (CS): closing this thread for now — renewal risk mitigated for the demo window. Will re-open if anything anomalous shows up. :white_check_mark:
